reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "lambda-promtail Fix panic in lambda-promtail due to mishandling of empty DROP_LABELS env var", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A panic in lambda-promtail caused by an empty DROP_LABELS env var is fixed; no operator action is needed.

proposed.statement: lambda-promtail no longer panics when the DROP_LABELS env var is empty.
